import os,re

        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]

            col=g[i][j]; h=w=1
            while i+h<H and all(g[i+h][jj]==col for jj in range(j,j+w)): 
                h+=1; w+=1
                break
            # hmm redo properly: expand width first
            pass
    # simpler brute force: scan for solid rects by per-row runs extended down
    out=[]
    for i in range(H):
        j=0
        while j<W:
            col=g[i][j]; s=j
            while j+1<W and g[i][j+1]==col: j+=1
